items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I was noticing the names Rubino, Triscari, Candoli, Morrello, Gozzo... [INTERVIEWEE] I don’t know what it is... there are a darm lot of — yeah that trumpet section with Tom Jones, it was a total Italian trumpet section.

ctx.x: Yeah. It helps if you can have that relation. Yeah. But it is, when you first start, you know I went out with Stan Kenton I was working Roseland Ballroom with a society band from Chicago. I didn’t even get out of the staff. The next night I’m playing lead with Stan Kenton. It’s kind of frightening.

You didn’t even get into the staff, right? Wow that’s a lot of pressure. And in sort of doing some preparation for this I was noticing the names Rubino, Triscari, Candoli, Morrello, Gozzo. And the vowels at the ends of these names, like what is it with the Italian brass player? Does it go back to the marching bands do you think?

I don’t know what it is. I always make a joke and say we’re the only ones dumb enough to want to play — to want to work that hard. No I don’t know what it is, there are a darm lot of — yeah that trumpet section with Tom Jones, it was a total Italian trumpet section.
